mapper.select: SELECT * FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE round_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE round_time <= #{maxRoundTime} AND round_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED_FINAL') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time ASC
SELECT * FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE round_time = #{roundTime} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_stock_market_round (round_time, round_status, bar_build_version, feature_version, buy_rule_version, sell_rule_version, allocation_rule_version, message_rule_version, expected_stock_count, usable_stock_count, attempt_count, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{round.roundTime}, 'PENDING', #{round.barBuildVersion}, #{round.featureVersion}, #{round.buyRuleVersion}, #{round.sellRuleVersion}, #{round.allocationRuleVersion}, #{round.messageRuleVersion}, 0, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (round_time) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING
